company.name: MedTrail
company.oneLiner: MedTrail serialises medicine packs at Nigerian distributors and tracks each one, so a recall finds every pack in hours, not weeks.

fx.note: USD equivalents use the company's management rate of NGN 1,520 per USD, the rate behind the deck's USD figures.

documentDefaults.preparedBy: Prepared by Vikram Chandiramani, Co-founder & CEO, from the company's ledgers; unaudited

basis: Revenue: each live warehouse pays a subscription of NGN 350,000 a month, and each pack scan is billed at NGN 3. Distributors are invoiced on the first day of the following month and pay within 30 days, so each month's receipts are the previous month's invoices.

Scanner kits (NGN 1,080,000 a warehouse) are capitalised and depreciated straight line over three years (NGN 30,000 a warehouse a month). The field installation and support team and scanner depreciation are reported in cost of revenue.
contractNotes: Distributor 01 (national distributor) has nine warehouses on subscription and scanned 421,500 packs in September 2026. Its contract runs for two years from 1 Feb 2026, with a recall service level of a holder list within 60 minutes of a recall notice. Each distributor owns its trade data under a data processing agreement.
Every other distributor is on the standard twelve-month subscription that renews automatically. No distributor has left since the first contract.

capTable.basis: Fully diluted, with the pre-seed SAFEs shown as converted at their cap.

funding.investors: Broad Street Health Angels and two pharmaceutical industry executives

useOfFunds.line: Engineering: recall console and regulator reporting

knownDiscrepancies.title: Gross margin: deck 72% against 42.3% in the accounts
knownDiscrepancies.note: The deck's 72% gross margin for September 2026 counts only cloud hosting, SMS and serial labels as cost of revenue. These accounts also put the field installation and support team and scanner depreciation in cost of revenue, which gives a gross margin of 42.3% for September 2026.

The seed ends at September 2026; October continues the trend.
